project.name: MailForge
project.description: MailForge is a production-oriented bulk email campaign management platform for managing contacts, audiences, email templates, campaigns, email delivery, scheduling, tracking, analytics, suppression and external email campaign integrations.

DATABASE_URL.description: Primary asynchronous PostgreSQL database connection string.

SYNC_DATABASE_URL.description: Synchronous PostgreSQL database connection string for migrations or synchronous infrastructure operations.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection string used for caching, Celery broker and background-job coordination.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign JWT access tokens.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Application encryption key used to encrypt sensitive credentials such as provider secrets.

ZEPTOMAIL_MOCK.description: When enabled, ZeptoMail delivery is mocked for local development.

ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_MOCK.description: When enabled, Zoho Campaigns API operations are mocked for local development.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname retained as a configurable provider option.

security_rules: Never expose secrets to the frontend.
Never return provider secrets through API responses.
Encrypt stored provider credentials using ENCRYPTION_KEY.

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.responsibility: HTTP API endpoints, request validation and response serialization.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.responsibility: Database, Redis, external APIs and email providers.

dependency_direction: Domain does not depend on FastAPI
Domain does not depend on PostgreSQL
Domain does not depend on Redis
Domain does not depend on ZeptoMail
Domain does not depend on Zoho

audiences.responsibility: Manage lists, tags and dynamic segments.

integrations.responsibility: Integrate MailForge with external campaign infrastructure.

provider_rules: Application code must depend on EmailProvider abstraction.
CampaignService must never directly call ZeptoMail.
CampaignService must never directly call SMTP.
ZeptoMail implementation must be isolated behind an adapter.
SMTP implementation must be isolated behind an adapter.

zeptomail.purpose: Primary transactional/bulk email delivery provider for MailForge.

behavior: Do not make external API requests.
Log that mock delivery was used without exposing secrets.

zoho_campaigns.purpose: Optional external integration for synchronizing campaign and audience operations with Zoho Campaigns.
rules: Zoho access tokens must never be exposed to the frontend.
OAuth token management must be isolated from campaign business logic.
Zoho API failures must not crash the MailForge application.
Zoho integration must be independently mockable.

behavior: Do not make external Zoho API requests.
Allow local development without Zoho credentials.

smtp.purpose: Secondary or configurable email delivery mechanism.

relationships: many refresh tokens belong to one user

security: Never return encrypted credential values to frontend.

rules: Invalid state transitions must be rejected.
A sent campaign cannot be edited.
A campaign cannot be sent twice.
A campaign must have a valid audience before sending.
A campaign must have valid content before sending.
A campaign must have a valid sender before sending.

celery_tasks.name: queue_campaign
celery_tasks.responsibility: Resolve audience and create delivery jobs.

celery_tasks.name: send_single_email
celery_tasks.responsibility: Render and deliver an individual email.

celery_tasks.name: process_scheduled_campaigns
celery_tasks.responsibility: Find campaigns whose scheduled time has arrived.

unsubscribe_architecture.token: Signed or securely generated recipient-specific token

rules: Repositories do not contain campaign business rules.
Repositories do not call external providers.

principles: Campaign creation should feel like a guided workflow.
Use confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.

data_protection: Never expose backend secrets to frontend

imports: Do not load huge CSV files entirely into memory.
email: Never send bulk email inside an HTTP request.

critical_tests: Permanent provider failure does not endlessly retry.

acceptance_criteria: MailForge uses the exact environment variable set defined in this specification.
The backend is implemented in Python FastAPI.
The frontend is implemented in React TypeScript Vite.
Redis is used for queueing and background coordination.
ZeptoMail is the primary email provider.
SMTP is available as an additional provider.
ZeptoMail mock mode works using ZEPTOMAIL_MOCK.
Zoho Campaigns mock mode works using ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_MOCK.
Unsubscribed recipients cannot receive future campaigns.
The application follows Clean Architecture and SOLID principles.

final_instruction.build: Build the complete MailForge application exactly according to this specification.
important: This is MailForge, not a Zoho clone.
Zoho Campaigns is an integration, not the identity of the product.
ZeptoMail is the primary email delivery provider.
SMTP remains available as a provider option.
Use the exact environment variable names specified.
Use Python FastAPI for backend implementation.
Use Redis and Celery for background processing.
Implement provider adapters instead of coupling business logic to external APIs.
Implement mocks for ZeptoMail and Zoho so local development does not require external credentials.
final_instruction.definition_of_done: MailForge is complete when a user can authenticate, manage contacts and audiences, create templates, configure email delivery, create and review campaigns, send or schedule campaigns, process recipients asynchronously through Celery and Redis, deliver through ZeptoMail or SMTP, integrate with Zoho Campaigns where configured, track delivery/open/click events, process unsubscribes and suppressions, and view campaign and system analytics through the MailForge interface.
